key.name: palette-size
key.description: How many dominant colors are extracted when a palette is made from an image.

key.name: export-format
key.description: The file format proposed first when a palette is exported.

key.name: vision
key.description: The color vision deficiency simulated on the image and its palette.

key.name: contrast-level
key.description: The WCAG level the contrast fix aims for.

key.name: contrast-large-text
key.description: Whether the contrast fix uses the lower requirement for large text.

key.name: contrast-adjust
key.summary: Color changed by the contrast fix
key.description: Whether the contrast fix changes the text color or the background.

key.name: last-image
key.description: The image a palette was last made from, opened again at start.

key.name: last-view
key.description: The view shown when Color Picker was last used.

key.name: copy-format
key.description: The format used when a color is copied from the quick settings tile, the overview widget or the search.

key.name: panel-button
key.summary: Show a button in the top bar
key.description: Whether the desktop shows a Pick a Color button in the top bar.
